description_en: Creates a custom endpoint for a database instance
description_zh: 该接口，用于为数据库实例创建自定义的连接地址（Endpoint）
kebab_example: aliyun polardbx create-custom-endpoint --db-instance-name pxc-hzjasd0000 --name ext-win-live-17 --vpc-id vpc-bp1ndoug37dtwoedlmru0 --vswitch-id vsw-000000000 --node-ids r-bp1l5kfgw80000c3iv --node-auto-enter true --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCustomEndpoint

parameters.help_en: The name of the access control instance. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. The name can contain digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 访问控制实例名称。名称长度为2~128个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) in which the endpoint resides
parameters.help_zh: 访问端点所在的专有网络ID
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the monitored nodes when RemindUnit (object type) is set to NODE (node). Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). A maximum of 50 nodes can be monitored by a single rule
parameters.help_zh: RemindUnit（对象类型）为NODE（任务节点）时，监控的任务节点ID。多个ID之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔，一个规则最多监控50个节点
parameters.name: node_ids

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the node automatically joins the cluster and starts providing services after being added or recovered
parameters.help_zh: 节点在被添加或恢复后，是否自动加入集群并开始提供服务
parameters.name: node_auto_enter

parameters.help_en:
To query the metrics of a read-only node in a cloud-native read/write splitting architecture instance, specify READONLY for this parameter along with the specific NodeId.
In other cases, you do not need to specify this parameter or you can specify MASTER
parameters.help_zh:
若希望查询云原生版读写分离架构实例中只读节点的指标，您在传入具体NodeId的同时，还需要在本参数传入READONLY。
其余情况请无需传入（或传入MASTER）
parameters.name: node_role

parameters.help_en: The region in which the instance resides
parameters.name: region_id
